svg.title: Measured: 67% of a week's token cost was re-reading old context. Simulated: compacting at task ends costs 28 to 37% less.
svg.text: of a week's token cost was
re-reading old context: 46% cache reads, 21% rewrites
Token cost at API list prices, one user, one week of heavy use (October 2026).
The second bar is a simulation, not a measured saving. Method and every number: docs/MEASUREMENT.md.
